name: gitlab-oidc-aws
description: Terraform and a sample .gitlab-ci.yml that let GitLab CI/CD jobs use AWS without stored access keys, using short-lived OIDC tokens. The trust policy checks both the audience and the project and branch. Companion to my article on the topic.

name: terraform-aws-secure-s3
description: A small reusable Terraform module for an S3 bucket with secure defaults: public access blocked, ACLs disabled, encryption (SSE-S3 or KMS), TLS-only access, versioning and lifecycle rules.

name: argocd-gitops-demo
description: A minimal GitOps setup with Argo CD: an app-of-apps root, a Kustomize base with dev and prod overlays, auto-sync for dev and manual sync for prod.
